positions.name: MeridianDeploymentGateRequirements
positions.frame: how are release integrity gates and artifact verification enforced across Meridian staging and production deployments?
positions.why: Quinton's operational mandate and risk-justified rationale regarding unsigned artifacts reaching staging (src-1) cohere directly with the explicit gate specification, environment scope, and assigned accountability (src-2, src-3, src-4) to define the release control mechanism for the Meridian train.
